name: Measure-Theoretic Isomorphism
description: Translated the scheduling constraints into an abstract measure theory problem. "Total duration" becomes the Lebesgue measure of subsets of [0, T]. "Non-overlapping" becomes pairwise almost disjoint sets (intersection measure 0). "Sequence dependency" becomes a supremum/infimum inequality. This forces the model to mathematically prove that the maximum measure of disjoint sets in [0, T] is T, and that sup(A) <= inf(B) implies mu(A)+mu(B) <= T, completely breaking any surface-level pattern matching on "duration", "load", or "overlap".
